title: 北都开发要20年：郭美雪开发商不只看地产，财团已愿投入，执行能否跟上？
speaker: Michelle Kwok

segments.en: It seems like some of the more local property developers at least from our reporting or a bit hesitant to kind of go all in in this development. What do you think are still some of the hurdles for the private sector to hit part in terms of
segments.zh: 据我们报道，一些本地地产开发商似乎有点犹豫，不愿全力投入这个开发项目。你认为私营部门参与还有哪些障碍？

segments.en: Resassessment because this is a vast project that takes basically 20 years to develop so developers if you think about. Financial capability they have to think about not beyond real estate. It's about industry. It's about jobs
segments.zh: 重新评估，因为这是一个庞大的项目，基本需要20年开发。开发商要考虑财务能力，不能只看地产，还要看产业和就业

segments.en: And then real estate real estate will come so long as we have industries established. So what we think is per the results of the first-hander
segments.zh: 只要产业建立起来，地产自然会跟上。所以我们认为，就首次招标结果而言

segments.en: Two bits good or bad. Is it really that relevant but what we have at the moment is a consortium
segments.zh: 好坏与否，真的那么重要吗？但目前我们有一个财团

segments.en: Willing to invest in this project and I think from this point on we shall then focus on. Execution of what goes on. Beyond the current tender results that we've seen. What do you want to hear from the chief executive today?
segments.zh: 愿意投入这个项目，我认为从现在起我们应关注执行进展。除了目前的招标结果，你今天想从行政长官那里听到什么？

segments.en: Specifically when I come to Northern metropolis because there's not that many initiatives or at least metrics so far. What what the vision is so anything that we can measure like everything that we can quantify in terms of investments
segments.zh: 特别是关于北部都会区，因为目前举措或指标还不多。愿景是什么，任何可衡量、可量化的投入
